security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: A local-first password manager for KeePass vaults
bundle.longDescription: Argus is a local-first desktop password manager that reads and writes standard KeePass (.kdbx) files, so your vaults stay portable to KeePass and KeePassXC. Your data never leaves your device.
